description: This file contains unit tests for the PhotosHandler class in an Android application. It tests permission handling and JSON response processing for photo retrieval functionality.

classes.name: PhotosHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for PhotosHandler, extending NodeHandlerRobolectricTest to test photo handling logic.

classes.name: FakePhotosDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of PhotosDataSource used for testing, simulating permission checks and photo data retrieval.

methods.name: handlePhotosLatest_requiresPermission
methods.description: Tests that photo handling requires proper permission and returns an error if permission is missing.

methods.name: handlePhotosLatest_rejectsInvalidJson
methods.description: Tests that invalid JSON input results in an 'INVALID_REQUEST' error.

methods.name: handlePhotosLatest_returnsPayload
methods.description: Tests that valid photo data is correctly processed and returned in JSON format.
